As the ASHA workers’ protest in Bengaluru enters its 11th day, the sit-in at Freedom Park continues despite rain and difficult conditions.
The protest highlights the crucial role ASHA workers play in the public healthcare system, handling a wide range of responsibilities while continuing to be classified as “volunteers”. Their demands centre on better remuneration, recognition and acknowledgement of the work they do.
Reporting: Rishita Khanna
Video & Editing: Ravichandran N
